title: Object Storage: plan capacity gb
content:
Object Storage plan capacity gb is defined as follows: Reference hot-storage capacity of the selected tier; GB integer.

| Contract tier | Plan capacity gb |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | plan capacity gb: 5000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | plan capacity gb: 10000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | plan capacity gb: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | plan capacity gb: 50000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | plan capacity gb: 100000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | plan capacity gb: 250000 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the plan capacity gb entry is 5000.
